convention: delta = P0 - P1; p_red = -EA; higher_is_better = True on both axes

T3_rigid_offset_invariance.statement: delta -> delta + c leaves sigma, tau_b, f_unresolved, f_robust_inv unchanged

T4_closed_form_unresolved.statement: f_unresolved(layer B, z) = Pr( q_ij > sqrt(2)/z ), q_ij = |delta_i - delta_j| / |DeltaP_ij|

rank_shift_monotone_never_unresolved.statement: a shift that is monotone in the target axis keeps tau_b = 1 and f_unresolved(z=1) = 0 for every amplitude

linear_shift_matches_theory.statement: delta = b (target - mean) gives q_ij == |b| for every pair, tau_b = sign(1 + b) and f_unresolved(z) = 1 iff |b| > sqrt(2)/z

predictability.target_definition: top-20% overlap before vs after < 1, i.e. the two-slot shortlist changed
